sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: All This Filth... is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Greetings, kid. We've seen a sudden surge of activity in four different parts of the city recently... It needs to be dealt with. If you aren't afraid, lend me a hand. Get rid of this filth that's poisoning our city."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 20 Scavs on Interchange, Ground Zero, Woods or Customs

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"So you weren't afraid after all... Good. It's reassuring to see."
